newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soymeal mixed, soyoil higher with soybeans.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soymeal mixed, soyoil higher with soybeans.

text.p: CBOT soyoil futures were higher early Thursday in line with soybeans and soymeal futures were mixed, traders said.
Soyoil futures shrugged off the fact that the U.S. Department of Agriculture reported no soyoil export sales during the week ended June 5.
Export sales for soymeal were seen as "okay" by traders. Old crop sales were a modest 19,200 tonnes, and new crop sales were 92,7000 tonnes, sources noted.
Support in July soymeal came mostly from the rally in soybeans, traders said.
In early soymeal trade, Continental Grain bought 250 lots July and LIT and Refco each bought 100 lots July, pit sources said.
At 1015 CDT, July soymeal was up 0.50 per ton at $274.60, and other months were down $1.20 to $0.50. July soyoil was 0.21 cent a lb higher at 23.39 and other months were 0.22 to 0.28 higher.
